nom: Vibriance Super C Vitamin C Serum for Mature Skin

segments.oily: The one reviewer with very oily skin reports the serum felt slightly greasy on application but absorbed quickly and did not increase her oiliness.
segments.dry: Reviewers with previously dry skin report it now feels soft and hydrated instead, and some rely on it in place of heavier moisturizing creams.
segments.sensitive: Several reviewers who describe their own skin as sensitive, including one with her 90-year-old mother's thin, reactive skin, report no irritation at all; by contrast, a number of reviewers who say they don't normally react to products report severe reactions, including burning, swelling, and hives.
segments.mature: Reviewers span their 50s to 90s and overwhelmingly describe softer, smoother, brighter skin with reduced fine lines and lightened dark spots after weeks to months of use; this is the product's core audience.

concerns.aging: Most reviewers report brighter, firmer, smoother-looking skin and reduced fine lines after weeks to months of use, but a few report no visible change in wrinkles even after 3-4 weeks of daily use.
concerns.dehydration: Many reviewers, including some with previously dry skin, report the serum leaves skin moisturized and soft; one detailed review notes it absorbs quickly and recommends layering a moisturizer afterward since it can leave dry skin feeling under-moisturized on its own.
concerns.redness: A notable number of reviewers, including some who say they don't normally react to skincare, report severe reactions such as facial burning, swollen eyes, hives, or blistering that in some cases required medical treatment; conversely, many reviewers, including several with self-described sensitive skin, report zero irritation.
concerns.spots: Most reviewers who mention dark or age spots report visible lightening within two to four weeks, but at least two reviewers report no change in their dark spots or discoloration despite weeks of consistent use.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer with occasional breakouts and clogged pores chose not to continue after reviewing the ingredient list, citing silicones and ethylhexyl palmitate as pore-clogging risks for her skin.

aspects.libelle: Opaque bottle protects vitamin C potency
Gel texture absorbs quickly, slightly tacky
Bottle mostly empty air, weak pump
Quality-control issues: broken pump, crooked label

extraits.texte: As many others have said, beware!. I used this product and my entire face and neck look like I had been burned. My eyes were swollen shut for two days. Multiple people have said this in their reviews. I am not sensitive to products, but this one was horrible. I don’t usually write a review for a product, but I’m doing this as a warning to other buyers. It seems to be an issue for many folks that purchased this product. Unless you want to visit to the ER or your doctor with severe burning, as well as your eyes swollen shut, don’t buy his product!

I knew this probably wouldn't work for me when I read the ingredients and unfortunately saw things like silicones and ethylhexyl palmitate which will clog my pores and increase acne. The smell is also stronger then other vitamin c serums I've used - not necessarily unpleasant but smells like tang/orange drink. It went on well and it didn't irritate my skin at all but due to my issue with occasional break outs and clogged pores I probably won't continue using it. I might use it for my hands instead as they can also show signs of aging.

extraits.titre: Used for almost 4 weeks with no visible results
extraits.texte: The bottle arrived wrapped in plastic wrap with no instructions included. It went on smoothly, has a light, orange scent, and did not irritate my skin at all. I had high hopes for this serum. Unfortunately after 4 weeks of daily use, I have seen no visible results. I have included before and after photos. My dark spots, skin tone, and wrinkles seem unchanged to my untrained eye. Not worth the $$ for any minor results that might be accomplished with more time.

I like the way it feels on your skin. My makeup goes on without caking up or rolling off. It does help keep my dark spots lighter. Definitely helps my pores look smaller. One bottle lasts a long time too. I am 83 years old. It helps a lot.

extraits.titre: Smells great I'd say it's grapefruit scented
extraits.texte: Amazing scent and feels really good on my skin and my skin is very sensitive and I've not had any adverse reactions.its pricey but other than that it's very nice.

extraits.titre: It might be working… It’s definitely not hurting!
extraits.texte: I’m 56 years old, and I’ve been using this product faithfully for 2 months. As with anything like this, any improvement is going to be so gradual it’s hard to notice, unfortunately l don’t have any comparable before pics… but I will say this… in the last few weeks I’ve received several compliments on my skin! By nature I have Very Oily skin, and I was pleasantly surprised that it didn’t increase with this product. I did read all the reviews and I’ve never had any kind of bad reactions, I did see some reviews that said it dried their skin out… but the instructions clearly state that you can use your moisturizer after applying this… I usually apply my moisturizer about 3 to 5 minutes after letting my skin absorb this product! When you first put it on, a little bit goes a long way, and it feels greasy at first while applying, but give it a couple minutes and it absorbs right in! I love the way my skin feels!! It also smells really good too! My skin does feel a whole lot better since using it, and so far I really have no complaints!

extraits.titre: Not irritating! My 90 year old mom uses it.
extraits.texte: My mom is English and has paper thin skin. She actually found this somehow and told me about a couple of years ago. Her skin is thin and sensitive and she has reactions all the time. But not with this. At all. It’s gentle and silky and I get complimented all the time with no make up on. It reflects light and has quality ingredients. I’ve been using this for several bottles now and I’m highly sus of the lower star reviews even tho there aren’t many. This stuff is miraculous. My pores even look smaller. They better never stop making it!
